NewsArticle.Title: System Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: Two powerful entities have recruited to their sides over a dozen individual Aislings. These Disciples are now gathering forces to either protect the fair lands of Temuair or to overthrow them. The powers of Chaos have now granted their followers the ability to summon minor skeletons from the abyss. Meanwhile, the powers of Light have given their supporters the ability to banish them.
